title: Dropout-GRPO: Variational Stochasticity for Continuous Latent Reasoning
title_zh: Dropout-GRPO：用于连续潜在推理的变分随机性
abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) relies on the diversity of $K$ rollouts within each group; otherwise, the group-mean advantage $A^{(k)} = r^{(k)} - μ_r$ collapses to zero. This presents a structural challenge for latent-reasoning models like Coconut, which feed continuous hidden states recurrently in place of discrete chain-of-thought tokens. Because the latent phase is inherently deterministic given the parameters and prompt, multiple rollouts produce identical trajectories, stalling GRPO's progress. Consequently, applying group-relative reinforcement learning to continuous latent reasoning has proven difficult. To address this, we propose sourcing the necessary stochasticity through structured dropout. By applying a single Bernoulli mask held constant across all latent recurrence steps for a given rollout, we generate essential trajectory variance. This shared mask effectively treats each rollout as a posterior sample from a variational distribution over parameters, allowing GRPO to optimize the expected reward of a Bayesian model-average policy. We provide both theoretical justification for this method -- including unbiasedness, variance reduction, and the well-definedness of the latent gradient -- and empirical validation. On GSM8K, dropout-GRPO improves a Coconut baseline from $27.29\%$ to $29.01\%$ pass@1, demonstrating the viability of GRPO learning for latent-reasoning models. Our work positions this as a practical, theoretically grounded approach for post-training latent-reasoning LLMs.
abstract_zh: 本文关注将 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）应用于 Coconut 等连续潜在推理模型时的关键困难：GRPO 依赖同一组内 K 次 rollout 的多样性来计算相对优势，但连续 latent phase 在给定参数和 prompt 时通常是确定性的，导致多次 rollout 轨迹相同、优势坍缩为零，训练停滞。作者提出 Dropout-GRPO，通过在每次 rollout 中采样一个 Bernoulli dropout mask，并在所有 latent recurrence steps 中保持该 mask 不变，为潜在推理过程注入结构化随机性。该共享 mask 可被解释为从参数变分后验中采样，使 GRPO 优化 Bayesian model-average policy 的期望奖励。论文从理论上证明了该方法的无偏性、方差降低性质以及 latent gradient 的良定义性，并在 GSM8K 上验证其有效性：Dropout-GRPO 将 Coconut baseline 的 pass@1 从 27.29% 提升到 29.01%。
key_points_zh: 指出连续潜在推理模型在 latent phase 中缺乏 rollout 随机性，导致 GRPO 的组内相对优势退化，难以有效学习。
提出 Dropout-GRPO：每次 rollout 采样一个 Bernoulli mask，并在所有 latent recurrence steps 中共享，以产生稳定的轨迹多样性。
将共享 dropout mask 解释为变分参数后验采样，从而把训练目标视为优化 Bayesian model-average policy 的期望奖励。
提供理论分析，涵盖估计无偏性、方差降低以及连续 latent gradient 的良定义性。
在 GSM8K 上将 Coconut 的 pass@1 从 27.29% 提升到 29.01%，表明 GRPO 可用于后训练 latent-reasoning LLMs。

llm_assessment.comment: Dropout-GRPO is a narrow post-training technique for latent reasoning and has little direct relevance to agent platform reliability or evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: Dropout-GRPO 是面向潜在推理的较窄后训练技术，与智能体平台可靠性或演化的直接关系较小。
